id./param/scenario/cs/c_090_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"{var:1}! Why are you here!?
  ...No, that can wait. Look at that!

"Everyone's gone strange. Just like when I
  drank the Strongman's Extract, they're
  overflowing with evil power...

"Only Arachtor could pull this off...
  But {var:1} defeated him...

"Anyway, first we have to
  snap everyone out of it!
  Lend me your strength, {var:1}!!

"Heh heh heh... Power wells up from deep inside.
  I feel like I could smash anything now...

"Bero! Bero-ro-ro...!
  What does your blood taste like?
  Can't wait!

"Hee hee... I'm so glad to fight you again.
  I'll show you a very different Sinderella
  this time, sweetie.

"Champ... I want to fight you.
  Hot and fierce, like back then!

"Sylvando, you're a man of the past.
  Now I can't live without
  Lord Arachtor!

"Let's go, you lot!!
  For Lord Arachtor!!
  Waaaargh!!
